reference.title: Anharmonicity and the equation of state for gold

methods.scope: Every Table 4 pressure; Au mixed with brucite 1:10 by weight

recalculation.notes: No paired Au lattice parameters or volumes tabulated; pressure errors alone cannot reconstruct them. No inverse-EOS synthetic marker observations are created.

assessment.basis: Agreement within the source's reported parameter error widths; this is not an inferred confidence convention.
qualifications: Conditional comparison against individual reported errors using every printed same-temperature row and the source expansion reference volume fixed. Unweighted pressure residuals, not author weights. At 873 K the K0 difference exceeds one reported error and the figure implies inconsistent volume normalization. Lattice-average fit includes H rearrangement; no phase-pure or original-workflow claim.
Usage recommendation: Source-checked isotherm at its stated temperature only. This does not validate the full published thermal EOS or an interpolation between temperatures.

scientific_validation.note: Primary equation, coefficients, units, uncertainties and source PVT observations directly checked. Published parameters preserved; exact author regression is not reproduced. Layered brucite lattice-average empirical volume EOS, including H rearrangement; not a hydrogen-order-resolved thermodynamic fit or a phase-boundary model. Fukui describes a higher-order H change; Sun (2025) XRD supports the layered average lattice beyond this range. Ambient atomic sites are a reference only.

primary_source_check.finding: BM3 and published moduli transcribed from Tables 5-6; V0 from Eq. (1) and Tables 2-3. Independent source observations checked; author weights and covariance unreported.
primary_source_check.record_note: V0 from Table 2; K0 and K0' from Table 5 (p. 515), repeated in Table 6, which prints the K0' error as 0.4 instead of 0.3. Equation (2) is the ordinary BM3.

primary_data_check.finding: All 48 sample observations, including negative reported pressure, repeated temperatures and errors preserved; original Au readings unavailable.

numerical_reproduction.conditional_coefficient_agreement: Pressure-sigma diagnostic fits agree with printed K0 and Kprime within each reported error; objective itself is not source-confirmed.

scientific_validation.usage_recommendation: Source-checked isotherm at its stated temperature only. This does not validate the full published thermal EOS or an interpolation between temperatures.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Powder X-ray isothermal compression; V0(T) from independent ambient expansion measurements. No acoustic or shock coefficients substituted.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table 2: V0(300)=40.917(12) A^3. For high-T slices, p. 513 states V0 was fixed from ambient expansion using Eq. (1) and Table 3 constant alpha=6.69(18)e-5 K^-1. V0(T)=40.917 exp[6.69e-5(T-300)]. Static compression V0 treatment is not separately stated; Table 2 anchoring is explicit here and subject to integration review. Derived high-T V0 errors are missing because covariance is unreported, not zero.
parameter_provenance.K0: Table 5 and duplicated Table 6, p. 515; Kprime error 0.3 in Table 5, 0.4 in Table 6
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Table 5 and duplicated Table 6, p. 515; Kprime error 0.3 in Table 5, 0.4 in Table 6
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: Exact listed isotherm; no interpolation or temperature extrapolation between records.

selection.source_exclusions: not reported; every printed same-T row retained in diagnostics

fit_provenance.objective: not reported; diagnostics compare three explicit objectives

superseded_record_text.notes: Layered brucite lattice-average empirical volume EOS, including H rearrangement; not a hydrogen-order-resolved thermodynamic fit or a phase-boundary model. Fukui describes a higher-order H change; Sun (2025) XRD supports the layered average lattice beyond this range. Ambient atomic sites are a reference only. Published coefficients unchanged. Original workflow and calibration re-reduction remain unavailable.
validity_notes: Layered brucite lattice-average empirical volume EOS, including H rearrangement; not a hydrogen-order-resolved thermodynamic fit or a phase-boundary model. Fukui describes a higher-order H change; Sun (2025) XRD supports the layered average lattice beyond this range. Ambient atomic sites are a reference only.
Measured pressure span at this temperature; no temperature interpolation by an isothermal record.
